categories.main_business_segments: Wangsu Science & Technology primarily operates in CDN and edge computing, cloud security, computing power cloud, MSP (Managed Service Provider), and green data centers including IDC and liquid cooling solutions. The company provides IT infrastructure services such as computing, storage, network, and security to internet, government, and enterprise customers globally. It has a diversified '2+3' business layout focusing on mature CDN and edge computing services plus emerging areas like security, computing power cloud, MSP, and liquid cooling data centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including content delivery network (CDN), edge computing platform (ECP) integrating computing, storage, network, and security capabilities, cloud security solutions like DDoS defense, WAF, BotGuard, API security, and zero-trust access. It also develops GPU and CPU cloud computing services, serverless container technology based on Kubernetes, and energy-efficient liquid cooling data center solutions. Continuous R&D focuses on resource optimization, intelligent scheduling, AI-driven security, and global network infrastructure.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Wangsu serves a broad customer base including large internet companies, government agencies, enterprises across industries such as video streaming, e-commerce, gaming, finance, automotive, retail, media, education, and healthcare. Its services support digital transformation and global expansion needs, with customers requiring fast, stable, and secure IT infrastructure and cloud services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China and overseas markets, with presence in over 70 countries and regions including Asia, North America, South America, Europe, Oceania, and Africa. It has subsidiaries and teams in Singapore, Korea, Japan, the United States, Malaysia, and other countries, supporting a global intelligent service network and localized operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wangsu operates primarily as a midstream and downstream IT infrastructure service provider, delivering network acceleration, edge computing, cloud security, and data center services. It builds and manages global edge nodes and cloud platforms, serving as a critical infrastructure layer enabling content delivery and enterprise digital services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes building an intelligent platform integrating transmission, computing, storage, and security capabilities with a focus on edge computing and security as core business pillars. It invests heavily in R&D for CDN optimization, AI-enhanced security, cloud-native edge computing, and green data center technologies like liquid cooling. Expanding overseas markets and deepening industry-specific solutions are key strategic directions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through fixed monthly fees and usage-based charges for CDN and edge computing services, cloud security subscriptions, managed cloud services (MSP), and data center hosting including liquid cooling solutions. The company also earns from sales of network and computing equipment and software development services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Wangsu is positioned as a leading IT infrastructure platform provider in China with a strong global footprint. It competes with other CDN and cloud service providers by leveraging its extensive global edge network, integrated security offerings, and emerging cloud computing capabilities. Its long-standing industry experience and diversified product portfolio provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Wangsu reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.7 billion, a slight decline from the previous year, but net profit attributable to shareholders surged by over 220% to RMB 613 million. The company maintains a solid asset base of nearly RMB 11 billion with a low debt ratio around 10.76%. Overseas revenue accounted for 45.52% of total revenue, growing by 12.84%. R&D investment remains robust at nearly 9.72% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wangsu emphasizes delivering fast, stable, and secure IT infrastructure and user experience through its globally distributed edge computing platform and comprehensive security solutions. Its integrated '2+3' business model offers one-stop services from CDN acceleration to cloud security, computing power, MSP, and green data centers. The company differentiates itself with advanced technology, extensive global network, strong customer relationships, and continuous innovation in AI and green computing.
